text: In Cartesian cubical type theory (ABCFHL, Angiuli-Brunerie-Coquand-Favonia-Harper-Licata), the interval structure is:
choices: only meet (∧) and join (∨) without complement (no ~)
explanation: Cartesian cubical TT uses only ∧ and ∨ on I (no complement ~). This means path reversal is not definitional. The advantage: a cleaner computational model.
